Given example: input 9x9 with shape 4s on 0 background. compress removes all-zero rows and all-zero columns? Let's see input rows: rows 0,1 all zeros removed. row2 [0,4,4,0,0,0,0,0,0] not uniform. row3 [0,0,4,0,...] not uniform. row4, row5 non-uniform. rows6,7,8 all zero removed. row3: [0,4,0]

row2 expanded [4,4,4,4,0,0] twice
row3 [0,0,4,4,0,0] twice
row4 [4,4,4,4,4,4] twice
